slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When you rent a contract of length L starting in month s, does it cover the required area for months s through s+L-1 (i.e., a 2-month contract starting in month 1 covers months 1 and 2), and can contracts of different lengths starting in the same month be combined to cover that month's requirement?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about the coverage period of a contract, which is related to full-term coverage, but did not explicitly ask whether a signed contract must be kept/used for all months in its term or whether partial usage is allowed.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether the plan must include at least two distinct contract lengths or whether a single contract type is acceptable.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a maximum limit on the number of distinct contract lengths or types.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total rental cost (sum of all contract fees) while meeting or exceeding the required area in each month?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether demand must be met exactly or whether exceeding is allowed, directly targeting the exact-satisfaction hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total rental cost (sum of all contract fees) while meeting or exceeding the required area in each month?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to minimize total rental cost.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No requirement to diversify contract lengths; any combination of contract lengths is allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a minimum diversity requirement, and the READY_TO_MODEL summary does not mention or confirm any such constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no cap on the number of distinct contract lengths or types that can be used.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a maximum number of distinct contracts, and the READY_TO_MODEL summary omits any such limit.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H2 (contract length diversity) remained unresolved; P0 slots H4 and H5 were resolved.

summary: The agent resolved the core P0 slots on exact demand satisfaction and cost minimization, but missed the P1 contract-length diversity requirement and the P2 limits on full-term coverage and maximum distinct contracts, stopping prematurely with H2 unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
